# Coreward — llms.txt

> Governance spine for agent-written code: preflight → bound work → evidence → promote.

- [README.md](./README.md) — lean cold path (pain → GitHub loop → also init)
- [docs/start-here.md](./docs/start-here.md) — init (`coreward:init`; `activate` = legacy alias)
- [docs/operate.md](./docs/operate.md) — Go / Approve / Merge + metrics kill criterion + Friday gate ritual
- [docs/ward-security.md](./docs/ward-security.md) — Ward + house rules vs Mandate

Also: [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — call MCP `preflight` once · [LICENSE.md](./LICENSE.md)

## Advanced

- [docs/capabilities.md](./docs/capabilities.md) — warm catalog (tiers, modules, honest limits)

## Commands

- `npm run coreward:init` — only recommended bootstrap
- `npm run activate` — legacy alias (compat)
- `npm run coreward:authorize -- --files a.ts,b.ts`
- `npm run coreward:metrics` — operator metrics show|record|comment
- `npm run coreward:dogfood-report` — compliance vs ≥80% kill criterion
- `npm run coreward:cost-dogfood` — bound vs unbound ratio (or `COREWARD_COST_CLAIM=off`)
- `npm run coreward:gate-candidates -- emit|list|show`
- `npm run gate:mcp` — MCP server `coreward-release-gates`
- `npm run ward:doctor`

## Product boundary

> **Product boundary:** Ward is CI/promote-only when a Mandate is on; IDE Edit/Shell remains out of band for this product generation; `ide_ward_interceptor` stays unbuilt.

## Non-claims

Not a kernel IDE sandbox. Hosted HPURL verify unbuilt (`hosted_hpurl`). CyberReady live buyer proof unbuilt (`cyberready_live`). No pricing tiers in this tree. No compounding SLA until gate candidates merge.
